reason: After reviewing the entire 20-F filing excerpt for Alpha Tau Medical (DRTS), no Total Addressable Market (TAM) figures were disclosed by the company. The filing contains extensive discussion of risks, business operations, clinical trials for Alpha DaRT technology across various cancer types (skin, oral, pancreatic, prostate, lung, liver, brain, rectal), and regulatory matters, but does not include any company-disclosed TAM figures, market size estimates, or addressable market valuations. The document focuses on risk factors, forward-looking statements, and business development rather than quantifying market opportunities.
